_note: Seed lists of known exotic hex colours per family (lowercase, no '#'). An off-default armour colour that exactly matches an entry here is tagged with that family; otherwise it is tagged generic 'EXOTIC'. The PURE list is exhaustive; the other families are intentionally small seeds — expand them from community datasets (e.g. the SkyBlock exotics community) for sharper sub-classification. The engine works correctly with empty families; it just labels more things 'EXOTIC'.
